_meta.target: all trackerdata.json entries at any depth, matched on country + url
_meta.method: kind=='journalism' -> media; otherwise the entry NAME matched one unambiguous pattern for a single skind value. Ten of the seventeen values are used. Buckets whose rules sampled below ~85 percent precision (conduct, index, prison, research, ngo, council) were dropped rather than shipped.
_meta.caveat: name-only classification; every unmatched entry is left at the existing default 'other', which is legal and visible
